$comment: Machine-readable install manifest. An agent reads this to install the server without asking anything it could have looked up. Keep it in sync with wrangler.jsonc — this file is the source of truth for AGENTS.md and verify.sh.
name: grok-mcp-server
description: Remote MCP server exposing xAI Grok's full capability surface, with an optional Xquik backend for the existing x_search tool.

accounts: An xAI API account with a funded/billed key (console.x.ai)
Optional: an Xquik API account when X_SEARCH_BACKEND is xquik

secrets.name: XAI_API_KEY
secrets.how: console.x.ai -> API Keys -> Create API Key. Requires a funded xAI account for anything beyond minimal free usage.
secrets.note: Outbound only — used by this server to call api.x.ai on your behalf.

secrets.name: XQUIK_API_KEY
secrets.how: Create an API key in your own Xquik account. Required only when X_SEARCH_BACKEND is xquik.
secrets.note: Outbound only. Used only by x_search when the optional Xquik backend is selected.

secrets.name: X_SEARCH_BACKEND
secrets.how: Set to xquik to route x_search through Xquik. Leave unset for the default xAI route.
secrets.note: Accepted values are xai, grok, and xquik. This does not affect the other eight tools.

secrets.name: AUTH_SECRET
secrets.note: Inbound auth gate (src/auth.ts), dual-route. Path A: static bearer 'Authorization: Bearer <AUTH_SECRET>'. Path B: OAuth/PKCE for the claude.ai connector (stateless HMAC tokens, no KV). This single secret backs both paths. Fails closed (503) when unset. Set without a trailing newline, per the set_with command above.

secrets.name: MCP_PUBLIC
secrets.how: Set to "true" only if you deliberately want the server to run open.
secrets.note: Escape hatch that disables the inbound auth gate on purpose. Leave unset in normal operation.
